description:
Cast the 0-cost artifact creature by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station and causing it to untap.
The 0-cost artifact creature enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station.
In response, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the 0-cost artifact creature, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 4, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever.
Myr Retriever triggers, returning the 0-cost artifact creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
